title: Recipe R: F + rotation +-180 on scene folds (ResNet18, 300 ep)
summary: Rotation aug + scene folds + v4+rot validation
hypothesis: Test images are rotated uniformly over 360 degrees; training and validation should include rotation.

leaderboard.note: not recorded as a separate submission

findings: Rotation-aware validation (v4+rot) became the reference protocol from here on.
rot8 test-time augmentation did not help once the model is trained with rotation (see EXP-011 onward: flip used).
limitations: Public score for this single model was not recorded.

evidence.code: Training code is in code/ (copied from the team server export, 2026-11-12). Referenced by md5: train.py 56d4db01cdd6c2c46e7b9b3b789324fe (before the 2026-11-12 patch that added --img and corrupt_v5; default behaviour unchanged), dq.py e3e270bdcdf254ad369b1cb3c345e5e9.
